about: Part c: the quests the lore speaks to, deepened in their givers' voices (drafted 2026-11-21 from LORE-FACTS.md and the Lore Library; owner approved).

entries.name: Return the Elddar Tome
entries.before:
Hatebone orcs have attacked and pillaged our town. Among what they carried off was an Elddar tome.
Its pages hold some of the little that survived of the Elddar's wisdom. We cannot leave it to the orcs.
Even one of these orcs is too strong for you alone. Band together with other elves to bring the thieves down.
The hatebone thieves keep to the hills south of Fayspires. When you have the tome, return to me.
entries.after:
Hatebone orcs have attacked and pillaged our town. Among what they carried off was an Elddar tome.
Its pages hold some of the little that survived of the Elddar's wisdom. We cannot leave it to the orcs.
Solusek Ro burned the Elddar forest, and the dark elves burned Takish'Hiz. What this book keeps, no one can write again.
Even one of these orcs is too strong for you alone. Band together with other elves to bring the thieves down.
The hatebone thieves keep to the hills south of Fayspires. When you have the tome, return to me.
entries.why: TOMB-3/4: Solusek Ro, fall of Takish'Hiz

entries.name: Return the Elddar Tome
entries.before:
Tunare be thanked. What you have saved is priceless to our future.
Take this scroll of Holy Shock. Tunare's light can strike as surely as it heals.
Come back to me at level 7.
entries.after:

entries.name: The Elddar Tomes
entries.before:
Disaster has struck! Hatebone orcs waylaid a small elven band, killing them.
The elves were carrying the last known Elddar tomes. We will lose vast teachings if we don't recover them.
Even one of these orcs is too powerful for you alone. Band together with other elves to bring down the filthy beasts.
You will find hatebone orcs to the south of here. When you have recovered a tome, return to me immediately.

entries.name: Nature's Mantle
entries.before:

entries.name: The Songweaver's Tunic
entries.before:
I am Torenia Eaglesong, master of the harp and leader of the Songweavers of Tunare.
If you truly have an ear for music, I welcome you with open arms.
But before you become a full minstrel of the Songweavers, you must be trained in the bardic ways.
Go to Merchant Loramal and pick up a songweaver's tunic from him. Then report to Felthion Lightleaf for training.
You should find Merchant Loramal just down the ramp in this building.
entries.after:

entries.name: The Forestrunner's Boots
entries.before:
I am Eterin Nitegazer, guildmaster of the Scouts of Tunare. If your feet are quiet and your eyes are sharp, you are welcome among us.
First you must move like one of us. Merchant Skysparkle, here in Scout's Rest, will sell you a pair of forestrunner's boots for nothing.
Every apprentice of ours wears them. Put them on, then report to Teleni Treestrider to begin your training.

entries.name: Specialization
entries.before:
You came back to us whole. I had begun to fear that one of Dolby's errands had cost us another acolyte.
We keep a fair friendship with the people of Moradhim, and they are afraid. They believe the aviaks of the mountains are planning a raid.
Ullie Darktoe asked me to send help. The aviaks wear jewelry whose metal seems to hold magic, and Ullie wants to know what it is.
Ullie is at the inn just north of Coachman Doba, on the west side of the road. Sign Doba's ledger while you are there.

entries.name: The Nightkeep Gloves
entries.before:
During your time as an Initiate Shadowknight of Nightkeep you will learn many things, but discipline above all else.
Explore Grobb and learn it's ways better. Return when you are ready, I have some important villagers for you to meet.
entries.after:
During your time as an Initiate Shadowknight of Nightkeep you will learn many things, but discipline above all else.
Ykesha is dead and the frogloks hold Guk. Grobb needs shadowknights who do not flinch.
Explore Grobb and learn it's ways better. Return when you are ready, I have some important villagers for you to meet.

entries.name: Bound to Grobb
entries.before:
You now know of both binding and stables. Both of these will be important throughout your crusades.
Go now to Crusader Tursk who will throw you into combat. Tursk is an experienced Shadowknight, so listen to him well.
entries.after:
You now know of both binding and stables. Both of these will be important throughout your crusades.
Ykesha is dead, and Grobb is the strongest of the troll cities now. Do not be the one who makes it weaker.
Go now to Crusader Tursk who will throw you into combat. Tursk is an experienced Shadowknight, so listen to him well.

entries.name: Froglok Fishing Nets
entries.before:
Well done! I'm sure our lord was pleased by the terror you caused descending upon the frogloks.
As promised take this scroll of Malice. It is a minor curse that will weaken and dull your opponent's senses.
entries.after:
Well done! I'm sure our lord was pleased by the terror you caused descending upon the frogloks.
The frogloks took Guk when Ykesha died. Fear is how Cazic-Thule keeps trolls strong: make them fear us again.
As promised take this scroll of Malice. It is a minor curse that will weaken and dull your opponent's senses.

entries.name: The Shaman's Bracers
entries.before:
For thousands of moons have I enslaved and mastered the spirits of plague, hatred, fear, and strength.
Many are the things I have learned, as many are the things that we will teach you.
Know that the Dark Ones are we, the shamans and precursors of Grobb. Keepers of the Stealing Tree and advisors to kings.
It is through our casting that the warlords decide their courses, and through our will that the spirits grant warriors power.
Seek Merchant Risa nearby. Purchase Dark Ones bracers from her, they will aid you through the trials to come.
Worry not for their price, they have already been paid for by the blood of your predecessor....he did not survive the trials.
Return once you wear them and experience will be your reward.
entries.after:

entries.name: Bat Meat
entries.before:
While your destiny is known, the outcome is still unclear. Nevertheless it is time for you to taste combat.
The powers of the unclean spirits will grant you many abilities in your years to come.
But you must remember always to never rely on these abilities to the exclusion of yourself.
Go now into the swamps of Innothule surrounding Grobb and seek out the black bats that fly there.
The meat of the swamp bats is ripe with plague and disease which makes it very useful in our rituals.
Return 3 slivers of bat meat and I shall reward you with a malevolent ability.

entries.name: Bat Wings
entries.before: Right outside the city there many vermin that plague the area. You can find bats out there. Bring me two ruined bat wings.
entries.after:
Right outside the city there many vermin that plague the area. You can find bats out there. Bring me two ruined bat wings.
Plague is spreading over Norrath, and every cure we brew eats stock. Quick, quick, we need them!

entries.name: Badger Meat
entries.before:
We've had a situation in the forest recently which you might be able to help with.
It seems that many of the badgers outside the glade have become infected with an unknown plague.
I'd like you to hunt down a few badgers and bring 3 pieces of badger meat back to me.
Hopefully the druids will be able to use the meat to find a cure, but controlling the problem is the best we can do for now.
Good luck, badgers can be found in the grasslands just outside the glade entrance.

entries.before: Then go, and come back to me when it is done.

Then go, and come back to me when it is done.
A plague has come to Norrath and nobody agrees on its source. Two temples of Rodcet Nife must not quarrel while it spreads.

entries.name: A Crimson Robe
entries.before:
Good. We'll need all the help we can get to prepare for the exodus. However, we must first test your skills, of course.
You must acquire a crimson robe before we can begin. Merchant Felcia will sell you one down the hall behind you.
When you return with your robe we will talk about your tests.
entries.after:

Highbourne is built on earth, stone and Erud's words, and soon its ships will carry us across the ocean. Wizards will be needed there.
You must acquire a crimson robe before we can begin. Merchant Felcia will sell you one down the hall behind you.
When you return with your robe we will talk about your tests.

entries.after:
Go, then, and do not keep me waiting.

entries.name: Ore for the Forge
entries.before: Go, then, and do not keep me waiting.
entries.after:
Go, then, and do not keep me waiting.
I am the Last Smith, and I live alone in the Unkempt Wood. Brell Serilis made dwarves for the stone; I will not let my forge go cold.

entries.name: Margun Leafstrider
entries.before: Go, then, and do not keep me waiting.
entries.after:
Go, then, and do not keep me waiting.
Brell made the dwarves, and a dwarf pays his debts. Bring both, and I will teach you.

entries.name: The Thulite Anvil
entries.before: I'll see you soon. Good luck.
entries.after:
I'll see you soon. Good luck.
A smith who lives alone in the Unkempt makes his own luck. Brell keep ye.

entries.name: The Calling
entries.before: Go, and come back to me when it is done.
entries.after: Go. Takish Hiz fell to necromancy, and its dead still answer to those who know the words. Come back to me when it is done.

entries.name: The Kerran Disguise
entries.before: Sickness spreads from South Toxxulia. Kill the two that carry it, a diseased tempest panther and a pestiferous spider queen, west of Toxx's cave in the south of it.
entries.after: Sickness spreads from South Toxxulia, and no healer has found its source. Kill the two that carry it, a diseased tempest panther and a pestiferous spider queen, west of Toxx's cave in the south.

entries.name: The Kerran Disguise
entries.before: The sickness is broken. The Kerra thank you.
entries.after: The sickness is broken here, though the plague still walks the rest of Norrath. The Kerra thank you.

entries.name: Three Toxic Glands
entries.before: Three plagued creatures carry the glands: a plagued forest drake in south Toxxulia, a plagued siren at any siren camp, a plagued kobold hunter in the Stonebrunt Mountains.
entries.after:
The plague has spread across Norrath, and not even the Healers of Springview have found its cure.
Three plagued creatures carry the glands: a plagued forest drake in south Toxxulia, a plagued siren at any siren camp, a plagued kobold hunter in the Stonebrunt Mountains.
entries.why: PLAGUE-1: Healers of Springview, no cure

entries.name: The Code of the Old Scroll
entries.before: A traveller named Nolram Barro camps on a hill at the north-west corner outside Takish'Hiz. He carries an old scroll in a code I have long wanted. Bring it to me, and we will see what it hides.
entries.after:
The Teir'Dal ship all of Takish'Hiz's treasure north to Neriak, and I would have what they have overlooked.
A traveller named Nolram Barro camps on a hill at the north-west corner outside Takish'Hiz. He carries an old scroll in a code I have long wanted. Bring it to me, and we will see what it hides.
entries.why: HAZ-1/TOMB-5: Takish'Hiz's treasure shipped to Neriak; Nothard greed

entries.name: The Ring of Madrias: Magus Niska's Books
entries.before: Magus Niska, in the necromancers' guild in Klick'Anon, has lost four books of lore, one from each of the humans, the gnomes, the Erudites and the Teir'dal. Help him, and your ring grows.
entries.after:
The fleet for the Exodus rises beside my docks, and a Highman will not sail with his lore in disorder.
Magus Niska, in the necromancers' guild in Klick'Anon, has lost four books of lore, one from each of the humans, the gnomes, the Erudites and the Teir'dal. Help him, and your ring grows.
entries.why: ERUD-2: the Exodus fleet built at Highbourne

entries.name: The Truearrow Brooch
entries.before: Well done, mercenary. Your pay, and something pretty.
entries.after: Well done, mercenary. Takish'Hiz is ours without a rival. Your pay, and something pretty.
entries.why: TOMB-10: Cyrian Truearrow leads the last elves; fixes 'the Tier'dal camp'

entries.name: Terrorantula
entries.before: The Terrorantula has haunted these sands too long. Five parchments tell its history, scattered across Tak Xiv and Takish'Hiz. Bring me all five and I will learn how to rid Tunaria of it. Bind near Oasis.
entries.after:
These sands were Elddar's forest before Solusek Ro burned it, and the Terrorantula has haunted them too long.
Five parchments tell its history, scattered across Tak Xiv and Takish'Hiz. Bring me all five and I will learn how to rid Tunaria of it. Bind near Oasis.
entries.why: TOMB-3/12: Solusek Ro burned Elddar to sand

entries.name: The Death Knights' Hearts
entries.before: The Plague Lord's realm opens to few. Bring me the hearts of three death knights who walk Tunaria: Endraval, Bileheart and Halik. And see my assistant Xeptip first: you will need a suit.
entries.after:
The Plague Lord's realm opens to few. Lxanvon, the Xulous kings' necropolis, stood in these hills before it passed into his plane.
Bring me the hearts of three death knights who walk Tunaria: Endraval, Bileheart and Halik. And see my assistant Xeptip first: you will need a suit.
entries.why: Lxanvon stood where the Dead Hills are, now in the Plane of Disease

entries.name: Cleansing the Isle
entries.before: We of Graumord trust no one who has not bled for us. Cazic's creatures crawl over the pit east of town: kill them, and come back. Do it often enough and we will speak of more.
entries.after:
Graumord is a village of lost souls, and Cazic means us to stay afraid.

entries.name: The Trials of Cazic Thule
entries.before: Three trials stand between you and the Faceless: endurance, celerity and contention. The first: go down the long hallway alone, and survive what comes for you.
entries.after:
The Faceless hosts trials on this isle, and only the most worthy are meant to pass.

entries.why: DREAD-3: Cazic-Thule hosts trials on the Isle of Dread

entries.name: The Shadowknight Exemplar
entries.before: Bertoxxulous wants a disciple who spreads his rot. Urglauh the Foul, in the tunnel under the guard tower in the north of Trail's End, will take you. Tell him you were sent.
entries.after:
All things decay, and the Lord of Decay was born in the rot of dead kings.

entries.name: Duskrender's Trial
entries.before: Well hunted. Take this, and use it well.
entries.after: Well hunted. Levandius, the Wolf Father, hears of every cub who proves himself. Take this, and use it well.

entries.name: The Bear's Gift
entries.before: You have earned the bear's gift.
entries.after: You have earned the bear's gift. Ehayae, Matron of the Dawn, gave it to me, and I give it on. Heal as much as you fight.

entries.name: Trissen
entries.before: Trissen is dead, and you are one of the swarm. Welcome.
entries.after: Trissen is dead, and you are one of the swarm. Welcome. I was taken from a cradle myself; the family does not leave its own to be taken.
entries.why: WERE-15: Yindrius stolen as a baby by the Ratonga

entries.name: The WereHunter Trials
entries.before: The trials will test your sight, your memory and your nose. Have your were-hunter's ring with you. Nivaan D'Tarin waits on a floating raft in Bogman Village (NE).
entries.after:
Djivan Mertshak wrote the were-hunters' texts, and the Council holds every hunter to them.
The trials will test your sight, your memory and your nose. Have your were-hunter's ring with you. Nivaan D'Tarin waits on a floating raft in Bogman Village (NE).

entries.name: Elddar Seeds
entries.before:
Disaster has struck! Hatebone orcs waylaid a small elven band, killing them.
The elves were carrying the last known Elddar tomes. We will lose vast teachings if we don't recover them.
Even one of these orcs is too powerful for you alone. Band together with other elves to bring down the filthy beasts.
You will find hatebone orcs to the south of here. When you have recovered a tome, return to me immediately.
entries.after:
Disaster has struck! Hatebone orcs waylaid a small elven band, killing them.
They carried the last known Elddar tomes. When Takish'Hiz fell, most of our learning burned with it, and we will lose vast teachings if we don't recover them.
Even one of these orcs is too powerful for you alone. Band together with other elves to bring down the filthy beasts.

entries.name: The Elddar Tome
entries.before: Hatebone thieves stole the Elddar tome. Kill them in the hills south of town and get the seeds back.
entries.after: Hatebone thieves stole the Elddar tome. Kill them in the hills south of town and get the seeds back. Elddar must not die twice.

entries.name: Elddar Seeds

entries.after: Kill the hatebone thieves south of town and bring back the elddar seeds. Elddar burned once; it will not die twice.
